note: Re-judged 2026-11-14 by an independent auditor who authored none of 178cffd97d, 1c6795e9e4, 43cfa9af6e, after the cited producer Session.handleConnectionCloseLocked (session_read.go:778) changed: it delivered fsm.EventTCPConnectionFails and now delivers s.endEvent() (session_connection.go:620). RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Active) read at rfc/full/rfc4271.txt:3355-3376: "If the local system receives a TcpConnectionFails event (Event 18), the local system: - restarts the ConnectRetryTimer (with the initial value), - stops and clears the DelayOpenTimer (sets the value to zero), - releases all BGP resource, - increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1,". endEvent returns the stop event beginTeardown recorded, and Event 18 when none was recorded; Session.stopEvent has one writer, beginTeardown's CompareAndSwap. So a transport failure with no local teardown in progress still delivers Event 18 to the FSM with the same action list, and the Active path of this row is unchanged by the edit. When a local teardown began, the FSM receives that teardown's stop event from whichever goroutine reaches it first; that event's own action list ends in Idle, where RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 says "Any other event (Events 9-12, 15-28) received in the Idle state does not cause change in the state of the local system.", so replacing the consequent Event 18 with the stop event that caused the close loses no required action. The gap the verdict records is untouched: handleConnectionCloseLocked still calls timers.StopAll directly after the event, cancelling the ConnectRetryTimer FSM.handleActive restarted, and Peer.run still substitutes its exponential reconnect backoff for the initial-value retry. The row's gap annotation still describes the transport-failure path correctly. No test tags the row and it has no discrimination record, so nothing tagged for this requirement would go red if the transport-failure path stopped delivering Event 18; the untagged TestCloseCauseReachesTheStateEvent and TestRFC4271ActiveEvent18WithDelayOpen are the only guards and neither checks a live retry. Verdict unchanged: unimplemented, owned by plan/post-release/features/spec-bgp-fsm-delayopen-and-automatic-start.md AC-1e. Native commands were not run by the auditor.
